rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone or something is still in the same state, role, or identity.
Use this when a person or thing stays behind in a place instead of leaving, especially after others have gone.

example.english: You all go ahead; I’ll remain behind to look after the shop.
example.traditional: 你哋走先啦，我留低睇舖。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 zau2 sin1 laa1 ngo5 lau4 dai1 tai2 pou3

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that an action, process, or condition carries on without stopping.

example.english: Even if it rains, the match will remain in progress.
example.traditional: 就算落雨，個比賽都繼續進行。
example.jyutping: zau6 syun3 lok6 jyu5 go3 bei2 coi3 dou1 gai3 zuk6 zeon3 hang4

rows.note: Use this when a number or quantity is left after others or some of it has gone, been removed, or been used.

example.english: Only two cans of soda remain in the fridge.
example.traditional: 雪櫃入面剩返兩罐汽水。
example.jyutping: syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 zing6 faan1 loeng5 gun3 hei3 seoi2
